idea-plugin.name: DragonBall ProgressBar
idea-plugin.description:
🌟🚀 "Unleash Your Coding Power with Dragonball-Inspired Progress Bars!" 🚀🌟
Introducing "DragonBall ProgressBar" – a dynamic plugin designed to revolutionize the visual experience of progress bars within your development environment that recreates your Dragon Ball favorite battles.🐉 Completely free and effortlessly customizable from setting panel, this plugin injects creativity and action thanks to all the 45 (and more) characters and their moves into your coding journey!
Stay tuned for upcoming updates that will bring new characters! Special thanks, and credits, to all the artists of Ulsw (and similar) games for fighters sprites. Inspired by 'Hadouken Progress Bar'.
